title: Latvia kept a separate national noise-declaration copy
statusLabel: Residual national copy duty; legal significance under review
deadlineLabel: EU application date; adoption/publication due 28 November 2025
summary: The Commission-copy clause was deleted, while a copy to the national consumer-protection authority remains.
nationalGap: Current point 39 requires manufacturers or representatives to send PTAC a declaration copy. Point 40 is expressly deleted. Regulation 679/2025 removed only point 40 and added the EU amendment reference.
nationalLaw: Cabinet Regulation 163/2002, current version from 29 November 2025
provisions: National points 13, 37–41; amender 679/2025 points 1.6, 1.8, 2; EU Articles 2(1), 5(1).
consequence: Yes, on paper: a national submission duty remains. Its legal effect and actual use require further review.
resolution: The current official text retains point 39. Its amendment-history list contains no later change after 679/2025.
caveat: Retention, accompanying declarations and lawful surveillance remain separate. A deliberate national rule or EU-consistent interpretation may affect the comparison. The clause states no advance-submission deadline; no premarket condition, automatic fine or actual filing burden is inferred. The 2025 project was located, but its explanatory memorandum was not retrieved.

comparison.before: Declaration copy to PTAC still required.
comparison.note: The national and Commission copy clauses were separate.

review: Independent final current-text, authentic-amender and adverse-scope reviews passed. Official open-ended version and amendment list support currentness. Deliberate national design, legal equivalence and practical enforcement remain qualified.
recognitionNote: The government enacted and notified the reporting amendment. No published analysis identifying the precise surviving point 39 as an implementation mismatch was found in bounded official and public searches; no first-discovery claim.

noveltySearch.method: Bounded searches of exact national identifiers, point 39, the EU amendment and Latvian reporting/error terms across official sources and public commentary. Current legal texts and the adopted government project were located; no exact published mismatch analysis was found. Explanatory-memorandum access remains incomplete.

sources.title: Current Latvian noise regulation
sources.locator: Points 13, 37–41 and EU reference; official in-force version from 29 November 2025 with no end.

timeline.event: Current national clauses and later-law indications independently checked.
